title.raw: UMMC Lactation Team Supports New Mothers in Breastfeeding Journey
title.rendered: UMMC Lactation Team Supports New Mothers in Breastfeeding Journey

excerpt.raw: The University of Maryland Medical Center's lactation team provides education and support to new moms, reinforcing its commitment as a Baby-Friendly Hospital since 2017.
excerpt.rendered: The University of Maryland Medical Center’s lactation team provides education and support to new moms, reinforcing its commitment as a Baby-Friendly Hospital since 2017.

content.raw:
The University of Maryland Medical Center offers extensive support to new mothers through its lactation team, helping women initiate and maintain breastfeeding.

UMMC has held the designation of a Baby-Friendly Hospital since 2017, signifying its commitment to supporting mothers and babies during the breastfeeding process.

Additional resources and information about the benefits of breastfeeding are available on UMMC's website.

Source: Original Article
